chunks: And it is narrated from Jābir ibn ʿAbdillāh al-Anṣārī:
That the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله addressed the people and said:

O people, indeed Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has made lawful for you intimate relations in three meanings: an inherited union, and it is permanent marriage; a non-inherited union, and it is mutʿah; and those whom your right hands possess.

key_terms.غَيْرِ مَوْرُوثٍ: non-inherited, meaning a union not entailing inheritance
key_terms.مَوْرُوثٍ: inherited, meaning a union connected to inheritance rules
key_terms.مِلْكِ أَيْمَانِكُمْ: those whom your right hands possess

ai.seo_question: What forms of lawful intimate union are mentioned in this hadith from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم describing three lawful forms through which intimate relations were permitted. It distinguishes between permanent marriage, temporary marriage (mutʿah), and possession by the right hand, presenting the statement in a legal and classificatory manner.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4614 - It is narrated from Jabir ibn Abdullah Al-Ansari that:
The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, addressed the people and said: "

O people, indeed Allah (swt), the Blessed and Exalted, has made permissible for you intimate relations in three forms: an inherited relationship, which is permanent (Nikah); a non-inherited relationship, which is Mut'ah; and what your right hands possess (slavery)."
